notes.title: Join the Prototype Playtest
notes.content:
[b]Aether Effect[/b] is Now Available for Playtesting!

Visit the [b]store page[/b] to request access and experience the game.
This test will remain long-term, with the end date to be announced at a later time.

Please note: The game is currently in its [b]early development phase[/b], with core mechanics undergoing continuous iteration.
This test aims to openly share our progress and gather player feedback to help shape the final experience.

We warmly welcome bug reports, suggestions, or any other constructive input from our community.
[b]Thank you to all the players for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379870/
